content: Model/quality selector pattern (uxpatterns.dev): plain-language labels (Fast/Balanced/Deep) over raw model IDs, a visible current-model label, and a default rule communicating what happens automatically; heavier settings (cost/VRAM tradeoffs) belong in a settings panel with progressive disclosure rather than the main flow. getimg.ai/OpenAI pattern: quality/size dropdowns sit directly in the generation settings area, not buried.
